name: blackswan-globalfactors
description: The BALTUSSEN, SWINKELS & VAN VLIET (2021) 'Global Factor Premiums' replication — the paper's FOIL. Baltussen is the one prior human multi-asset unified test, reporting six style premiums (trend, momentum, value, carry, seasonality, low-beta) as ROBUST across asset classes over centuries. This reproduces the four feasible on the free survivorship-free panel — trend (time-series sign of the trailing return), momentum (cross-sectional 12m winners-minus-losers), value (cross-sectional LONG-RUN 5yr reversal, the commodity-value signal), low-beta (long low-beta / short high-beta) — plus Baltussen's headline DIVERSIFIED equal-risk combination, then subjects them to our discipline (realistic per-trade cost, Deflated-Sharpe / best-of-N multiplicity, mutation-proven point-in-time guards, deep-history OOS). SCOPE: Baltussen's SEASONALITY is tested by the `seasonal` probe (disproved) and CARRY is data-gated on free data (commodity carry ~ roll yield, tested by the `roll` probe, disproved; equity/FX/bond carry need term-structure / rates / FX not in the free panel). Thin module reusing tsmom/xsection/lowvol build_weights verbatim; the diversified unit-gross average is the only new (causal, mutation-checked) object. signal=published is Baltussen's direction, inverse the mirror control. Decider is DSR-deflated oos_sharpe across a MAJORITY of the 13 deep-history windows. PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION: the factors and their diversified combination FAIL net of cost OOS, contradicting Baltussen once frictions + post-2008 history are imposed uniformly. DATA: commodities/<SYM>-1d-*.json + etfs/<SYM>-1d-*.json.

universe.description: The multi-asset panel factors are formed on. diversified = 7 commodities + SPY/TLT/IEF/UUP, matching the rest of the battery.

factor.description: Which Baltussen style factor. trend = TS sign of trailing 12m return; momentum = XS 12m winners-losers; value = XS 5yr (long-run) reversal; lowbeta = long low-beta / short high-beta; diversified = unit-gross equal-risk average of the four (Baltussen's headline claim). An unknown factor is refused.

signal.description: published = Baltussen's direction; inverse = the exact negation (mirror control). Pre-registering both prevents post-hoc direction cherry-picking.

lookback.description: Formation window (bars) for trend + momentum. 252 ~ 12 months.

value_lookback.description: Formation window (bars) for the VALUE (long-run reversal) factor. 1260 ~ 5 years (Baltussen/AMP commodity value). Needs deep-train windows so the lookback is always available.

span.description: Trailing window (bars) for the low-beta factor's past-only beta estimate.

k.description: How many instruments on each side of a cross-sectional factor (long k / short k).

rebalance_days.description: Bars between re-rankings (21 ~ monthly, Baltussen's rebalance).

vol_span.description: Trailing window (bars) for the trend factor's inverse-vol sizing.

transaction_fee.description: Per-unit-of-turnover cost charged both ways (~0.1% round trip). The discipline Baltussen's low-turnover index-level premiums did not face.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED (all train from 2006 so the 5yr value formation is always available). A real factor premium must clear DSR-Sharpe in a MAJORITY of these 13 years.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the factors are fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept.
